schema_caveats: Raw eight-corner boxes include rotated OBBs; corner-pattern/orthogonality census reports recoverability. The reused v10 parser converts every box to AABB and loses that rotation. OBB axes still do not establish semantic front.
Room semantic types are absent unless counts explicitly show otherwise. Inferred types are heuristics, not annotated GT.
Occupancy JSON inspected only for schema; grid/image masks were not loaded.
R5 snapshot uses face_visible_v2; live working tree may be v3. V2 omits some structural-wall/curtain occlusion and is a geometry proxy, not RGB identifiability.
count_caveats: All counts are bounded CPU geometry candidates, not independent QA examples or validated images.
Counts reuse the same images/objects/pairs across capabilities and MUST NOT be summed into dataset size.
No successful question or answer text was created; candidate_objects was used only to audit existing referring-expression eligibility.
No scenes were replaced based on poor yield.
Existing R5 paths are short action certificates, not newly generated route-navigation/video questions.
Full-scene category count slots require every raw bounding-box instance in that category to be among sampled targets and geometrically visible; incomplete categories are not counted.
